from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper from the collection, its title, and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being parsed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers referenced in this paper's bibliography; filter out any paper titles not in the collection")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
